abstract.para: This topic guides you through editing an &agama; installation profile with schema-aware validation and autocompletion, so mistakes are caught before you start an unattended installation instead of during it.

section.title: Why validate a profile while you edit it
section.para: An &agama; installation profile uses JSON, which you can write in any text editor. Unlike XML-based &ay; profiles, though, JSON has no native way to reference a validation schema. Editors that support the unofficial $schema key can use it to flag invalid keys or values and suggest valid ones as you type, catching mistakes that would otherwise only surface once an unattended installation is already running. Visual Studio Code and Visual Studio Codium are the most common editors with this support.

warning.title: Editor-only, not used by the installer
warning.para: The $schema value is used only by the editor, for validation while you write the profile. The &agama; installer always validates against its own embedded schema.

The &agama; installer in version 16.0 does not accept the $schema key and complains that the profile is not valid. You have to remove the key before using the profile. The later versions (16.1 and later) accept the key but still ignore its value.

section.title: Requirements
section.para: A text editor that supports JSON Schema validation using the $schema key, for example Visual Studio Code or Visual Studio Codium.

section.title: Adding schema validation to a profile

step.para: Open your &agama; installation profile in a schema-aware editor.
Add a $schema key pointing to the profile schema matching your target product and version. For &productname; &productnumber; profiles:
Save the file. Your editor should now flag invalid keys or values and suggest valid ones as you type.

section.title: Summary
section.para: Adding a $schema key to your profile gives you validation and autocompletion while editing, catching mistakes before you start an unattended installation. Remove this key when you actually run the installation; the installer does not use it.

section.title: Troubleshooting
section.para: If the installer reports that your profile is invalid even though your editor did not flag any problems, run agama config validate against the file directly to see the exact validation error the installer would report.
